description: B12 — 卡罗坎防御推进变例，与法国兵链对比

intro.popup_en: Pawn-Chain Direction, Lesson 5: Compare the Caro-Kann and French chains. The French e6-d5 chain can leave e6 weak; the Caro-Kann c6-d5 chain avoids that weakness and is sturdier. Yet the counterattack principle is the same: ...c5 attacks the base on d4.
intro.popup:
兵链方向第5课
卡罗兵链 vs 法国兵链：
• 法国：e6-d5链，有e6弱点
• 卡罗：c6-d5链，无e6弱点！
结构更坚固，但反击方法相同：
c5攻根部d4！

outro.popup_en: The Caro-Kann chain is sturdier, but the ...c5 break against d4 still applies. White can use the resulting tension to establish Ne4. The direction of a pawn chain gives general guidance for both attack and defense.
outro.popup:
总结：卡罗兵链更坚固 → 但c5攻根部原则不变 → Ne4利用反弹
兵链方向的普遍原则！

moves.popup_en: ...c6 begins the Caro-Kann and prepares ...d5 without blocking Black's dark-squared bishop.
moves.popup: c6卡罗坎！准备d5但不封闭暗格象

moves.popup_en: ...d5! Black establishes the c6-d5 pawn chain, which does not create the same e6 weakness as the French structure.
moves.popup: d5！c6-d5链，无e6弱点

moves.popup_en: e5! White advances, but unlike the French chain, Black's c6-d5 structure has no e6 weakness and is more solid.
moves.popup:
e5！推进！但与法国不同：c6-d5链无e6弱点
黑方结构更坚固！

moves.popup_en: ...Bf5!! Black's bishop develops freely, a major advantage of the Caro-Kann structure compared with the French.
moves.popup:
Bf5！！象出！
卡罗的最大优势：暗格象已经通畅出动
法国做不到这一点！

moves.popup_en: ...e6 is an active choice here, not a structural necessity imposed by the French pawn chain.
moves.popup: e6黑主动e6：此时是主动选择，非被动结构

moves.popup_en: ...c5! Black attacks the base of White's chain on d4, applying the same Nimzo-style principle in the Caro-Kann.
moves.popup:
c5！c5攻根部！黑攻击白d4根部
——卡罗版Nimzo原则！

moves.popup_en: c3 supports the pawn on d4.
moves.popup: c3支撑d4

moves.popup_en: ...cxd4! Black exchanges against the base of White's pawn chain.
moves.popup: cxd4！黑方兑换根部

moves.popup_en: cxd4 rebuilds White's central structure.
moves.popup: cxd4白重建

moves.popup_en: Bb4! White develops the bishop and prepares queenside castling.
moves.popup: Bb4！象出发展，准备长易位

moves.popup_en: Bd2 blocks the check.
moves.popup: Bd2挡将

moves.popup_en: ...f6! Black attacks the head of White's chain on e5. The drawback is that the f-file opens, but Black gains counterplay.
moves.popup:
f6！f6攻链头e5！
代价：黑方f线开放，但获得反击机会

moves.popup_en: Rxf6 activates the rook by recapturing on f6.
moves.popup: Rxf6车进攻

moves.popup_en: Rae1 connects White's rooks.
moves.popup: Rae1双车连接

moves.popup_en: ...Qc7 develops the queen.
moves.popup: Qc7后出动

moves.popup_en: Nh4! The knight leaves f3 and prepares to support f4.
moves.popup: Nh4！马让出f3，准备f4

moves.popup_en: f4!! White launches the attack in the direction of the pawn chain.
moves.popup: f4！！白方沿兵链方向总攻

moves.popup_en: Na4! The knight reroutes via a4, preparing to occupy the important queenside square c5.
moves.popup: Na4！白马绕道a4，准备Nc5占后翼要点

moves.popup_en: ...Qd6! Black's queen becomes active, pressures the weak pawn on d4, and adds pressure to White's position.
moves.popup: Qd6！黑后活跃，盯住d4弱兵并施压白阵

moves.popup_en: a3! White reinforces the queenside and prevents Black from occupying b4.
moves.popup: a3！白方巩固后翼，防止黑方潜入b4

moves.popup_en: ...Rc8! Black occupies the c-file and prepares queenside counterpressure.
moves.popup: Rc8！黑车占c线，准备后翼反压

moves.popup_en: g3! White reinforces the kingside structure and prevents the black queen from entering.
moves.popup: g3！白方巩固王翼结构，防止黑后进入

moves.popup_en: ...Ne7! Black reroutes the knight, with options for Ng6 or Nf5.
moves.popup: Ne7！马重新调整，准备Ng6或Nf5

moves.popup_en: Bd3! White places the bishop on the d3-h7 diagonal and targets the weak pawn on g6.
moves.popup: Bd3！白象主动占据d3-h7对角线，瞄准g6弱兵

moves.popup_en: ...Rf7! Black's rook retreats to defend the f-file and support counterplay.
moves.popup: Rf7！黑车撤回f7，守护f线并支持反击

moves.popup_en: Qe3! White's queen occupies an active square, eyeing the isolated pawn on a7 and a possible kingside attack with g5. White has a clear positional edge.
moves.popup:
Qe3！白后强占e3！
同时盯住a7孤兵和g5进攻可能
白方位置优势明显！
